narr: An upper trough moving through the Southern Plains generated scattered to numerous thunderstorms across North and Central Texas on Thursday April 20. Storms were focused along a slow-moving cold front, and several of them became severe with large hail being the primary severe weather occurrence. Hail up to 2 inches was reported in Coryell County and hail up to 3 inches was reported in Collin County.
